actual_scope: Kappa-blocker KB5k (authorized explicit open request): THE SURVIVING BOX-FLOOR ROUTE to F-star, plus shareable-class completeness - the recorded remainder of PR 2978 (agent-78). (a) Does the sub-anchor box satisfy box(M) >= floor(2v/3) for every exact 3-total rational decoder (a proof would close F-star directly via cert >= box), or what is the MINIMAL decoder with box < floor(2v/3) (cert reported alongside, exact both)? (b) the shareable-class question of PR 2978 (its 21 unrealized v = 3 combinatorial gap patterns). (c) if the box floor fails but cert survives, the replacement lower bound linking named/box to cert in the shareable-class vocabulary. One bounded pivot maximum; smallest falsifying instance first.

bottleneck_link: F-star (cert(M) >= floor(2v/3), research/root-unit-decoder-lemmas section 7) is the named route to closing every open T = 3 window at once. PR 2978 killed the completeness link of the PR 2914 chain and left the box-floor link (box >= floor(2v/3)) as the surviving route. This package settles that route: the floor FAILS on the full class (minimal falsifier v = 3, cert = 3 >= 2 = floor > box = 0), so the route needs the tau >= 1 restriction; there the floor is PROVEN for v <= 4 (Lemma LB2) and stays open at v >= 5 (bounded exact search: 240 instances, 0 violations).
evidence: VERDICT: the box-floor route as stated (all exact 3-total rational decoders) is REFUTED, minimally at v = 3 in the rank-3 class. PROVEN: box = 0 iff every line has tau = 0 (a kept line needs a tied bit); the minimal falsifier F3-tau0 P = [[1,1,0],[1,0,1],[0,1,1]], Q = [[2,2,1],[2,1,2],[1,2,2]], M = I + 3J (rank 3, tau = (0,0,0), r_box = 3, no zero arcs) has cert = 3 (replayed witness; trivial upper bound v) > 2 = floor(2v/3) > 0 = box, both sides exact by the vendored engine AND an independent definition-level enumeration. PROVEN minimal: rank 3 forces v >= 3; a rank-2 wide-class falsifier exists at v = 2 (box = 0 < 1 = floor(2v/3)); v = 3 gradient tau = (1,0,0) gives cert = 3 > 2 > 1 = box; v = 4 tau = (0,0,0,0) gives cert = 4 > 2 > 0 = box. F-star is NOT refuted (cert >= floor on every falsifier). PROVEN (Lemma LB2, two-line repair): any two lines with tau >= 1 are jointly box-keepable, so box >= min(2, #keepable lines); machine-checked on 16761 canonical v = 3 configs and 160 random realizable decoders v = 4..6. Consequences: the tau >= 1 box floor is PROVEN for v <= 4 (threshold <= 2) and first open at v = 5 (threshold 3). CHECKED: v = 3 tau >= 1 domain min box = 2 = floor (3023 canonical configs recomputed, 27 gap candidates all exactly 2); mixed-tau formula on 240 realizable decoders; bounded v = 5 tau >= 1 search (240 exact instances, 97 with r_box = 2, 0 below threshold). Exact obstruction to a v = 5 falsifier recorded: Lemma RT caps a kept set at r_box only when all its forward pairs are zero arcs, so box <= 2 needs every 3-subset blocked in every order - Z-complete triples (all 6 ordered pairs zero arcs) are the only rank route and rank(M) = 3 permits them only for |S| <= 3; every other order must fail bilinearly. Shareable-class completeness (PR 2978's 21 patterns) remains open.
existing_restriction_being_changed: Audits PR 2978's stated surviving chain link 'a box floor box >= floor(2v/3) ... would close F-star' as a claim about ALL exact 3-total rational decoders. PR 2978's own counterexample has box = 2 = floor(2v/3) at v = 3 (not a floor falsifier), and PR 2936's tau = 0 demonstration is v = 2 with box = 1 = floor(2v/3) (also not one), so the floor itself was never tested against decoders with tau = 0 lines. This package tests it, refutes it minimally, and states the exact surviving form (tau >= 1 domain) with its proved range and bounded open range.
falsification_test: Every falsifier claim is falsified by replaying the stored witnesses and recomputing both rungs from the definitions: verify.py reruns the vendored PR 2914 engine (exhaustive) AND an independent definition-level enumeration (brute over all label assignments for v <= 3, trivial upper bound v for cert = v), asserts identities (tie parity, scope identity), rank = 3, and box == min(2, #keepable) on each falsifier. Lemma LB2 is falsified by any of the 16761 enumerated configs where its explicit construction fails the from-definition check. The v = 5 bounded claim is falsified by any tau >= 1 instance with box <= 2 (the search is bounded, NOT a non-existence result).
method: Smallest falsifying instance first. (1) Exact integer constructions with prescribed tau patterns at v = 2, 3, 4; exact cert/box by the vendored PR 2914 engine plus an independent section-7/box definition enumeration; int-only arithmetic; rank checked exactly over Q. (2) Written lower bounds: the keepable-line characterization (box = 0 iff all tau = 0), Lemma LB2 (two-line repair, constructive), and the Lemma RT/shareable-totals upper bound of PR 2978 for the obstruction picture; machine replay of the LB2 construction on every canonical v = 3 config with >= 2 keepable lines (including tau = 0 lines, which PR 2978 job B excluded) and on random realizable decoders v = 4..6. (3) Recomputation of PR 2978 job B (3023 canonical configs; the vendored receipt ships empty, so everything is recomputed from scratch). (4) One bounded pivot: exact kept-set feasibility ladder at v = 5 (threshold 3) over 240 realizable decoders from three generators (random valuation-tuned, extensions of PR 2978's counterexample core with r_box = 2, unit-role templates), exact box/cert on every would-be hit.
nearest_overlapping_prs: PR 2978 (Lemma V2, Lemma RT + shareable totals, minimal box = cert counterexample v = 3 - the predecessor and handoff source), PR 2963 (tied_min v = 11 exact, box weak cell), PR 2936 (Lemma BPP, tau >= 1 necessary for box = cert, tau = 0 demo at v = 2), PR 2914 (sub-anchor box, Lemmas SB/LB). None tests the box FLOOR against tau = 0 lines and none gives a box LOWER bound in terms of the tau pattern; this package does both and settles the floor's minimal failure.
